annotations.title: asksteps: change settings of an appointment type

description: Changes the settings you send of an appointment type; everything you leave out stays as it is — including the on/off switch, public booking, the public link and the assigned staff, which this tool never touches. Lists you send (excludedDates, modes) replace the stored list; an empty string removes color, bookableFrom, bookableUntil, intakeFunnelId or themeId. Requires "automation:write". An INACTIVE type can be changed freely. A type that is switched on can only be changed with the account's mandate "activate": without it the answer is "confirmation_required", NOTHING was written, and you hand the user the url. Call asksteps_get_appointment_type first.

spec.description: The settings to change. Fields you omit stay unchanged.

assignment.description: How a person is assigned: "pool" or "choose" (staff members — assigned in the studio, not here) or "org" (the organisation, no staff needed).

bookableFrom.description: First bookable day as "yyyy-MM-dd" (inclusive). An empty string removes the limit.

bookableUntil.description: Last bookable day as "yyyy-MM-dd" (inclusive). An empty string removes the limit.

bufferAfterMinutes.description: Buffer after an appointment in minutes, 0 to 240.

bufferBeforeMinutes.description: Buffer before an appointment in minutes, 0 to 240.

cancellationDeadlineHours.description: Hours before the start up to which a visitor can cancel, 0 to 720.

color.description: Colour as "#RRGGBB". An empty string removes it.

description.description: Description, at most 2000 characters. Empty text removes it.

durationMinutes.description: Duration of one appointment in minutes, 5 to 480. Required when creating.

excludedDates.description: Days that are not bookable, each "yyyy-MM-dd", at most 366. Replaces the stored list; an empty list clears it.

intakeFunnelId.description: The id of a questionnaire form of this account that visitors fill in before booking. An empty string removes it. A form that receives external submissions cannot be used.

inviteValidityDays.description: How many days an invitation link stays valid, 1 to 60.

key.description: Short key of the appointment type: lowercase letters, digits and "-", 2 to 40 characters. Omit to derive it from the name (creating) or keep it (changing).

maxAdvanceDays.description: How many days ahead appointments can be booked, 1 to 365.

meetingLeadMinutes.description: Minutes before the start from which an online meeting can be joined, 0 to 60.

minNoticeMinutes.description: Shortest notice before an appointment in minutes, 0 to 43200.

modes.description: The ways to attend, one to four of "online", "onsite" (needs locationId of an active location of the account — locations are created in the studio), "phone" and "visitor_address". Replaces the stored list. Required when creating.

closingText.description: Text shown to the visitor after booking, at most 1000 characters. Plain text.

locationId.description: The id of an active location of the account. Only (and required) for "onsite".

name.description: Name, at most 120 characters. Required when creating.

requireAcceptance.description: Appointments have to be accepted internally. Only with assignment "org"; otherwise false.

slotIntervalMinutes.description: Grid of the offered start times in minutes, 5 to 240. Required when creating.

themeId.description: Design of the booking page: a shipped design id (asksteps_list_themes) or "design-<number>" of the account (asksteps_list_designs). An empty string goes back to the account default. Unknown or foreign ids are rejected (invalid_theme).

name: asksteps_update_appointment_type

active.description: Whether the appointment type is switched on. A created one is always false.

issues.description: The problems found, with path and code. Empty unless status is "invalid".

path.description: Where the problem is, for example "parts[2].settings.templateId", "edges[0].condition" or "durationMinutes". Indices count in the list you sent.

shortcode.description: The shortcode at fault, when the problem is a shortcode. Empty otherwise.

note.description: One or two sentences for the user. After "created" it says that the type is inactive and what is still missing.

status.description: Outcome. One of: "created" (inactive, not publicly bookable), "updated", "invalid" (the issues say exactly what to fix; nothing was saved), "confirmation_required" (the appointment type is switched on and the account has not authorised an agent to change it: NOTHING was written, give the user the url), "stale" (someone switched the type on or off since you read it: NOTHING was written, read it again), "rate_limited" (too many changes to live objects in the last minute), "not_found", "not_connected", "error". Authorisation can also refuse before the tool runs: "plan_required" (the account's plan does not include agent access), "not_enabled" (the account owner has not switched agent access on), "permission_denied" (the connected user's role lacks the permission; the note names it), "mandate_required" (the owner has not granted a mandate for this). The note then says what the user has to do.

typeId.description: The id of the appointment type.

url.description: Path of the editor in the asksteps studio.

warnings.description: Warning codes of the saved type, for example "no_bookable_staff" (assign staff in the studio before switching on).
